title: Binance says it has reserved $6.34B+ in company funds, including $5B already held in impacted token assets, to deal with the fallout from the $6.3B hack (Rajveer Singh Pardesi/Reuters)
summary: Rajveer Singh Pardesi / Reuters: Binance says it has reserved $6.34B+ in company funds, including $5B already held in impacted token assets, to deal with the fallout from the $6.3B hack — Binance said on Friday it has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds, including $5 billion already held in impacted token assets …
